speaker: (a water-bearer)
text: Apprentices fetched a silkweaver out of the hospital. The gate was open when I came up. I saw the end of the running, same as you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I saw the gate, and a cap, and backs going north. I did not see them bring him out.

speaker: (a water-bearer)
text: The talk is the Lord Mayor put him in, for words at his door about the dearth. I had that from a man who had it from a man. I was not at the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it stays talk. I will not carry a door I did not stand at.

speaker: (a water-bearer)
text: The road is clearer than it was. I have water to get up the hill, and I am not a constable.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor am I. Go on. I am going on to the house.
